title: verify screenshot proxy changes and tests
description: Verify the current screenshot/proxy changes in main.py, screenshot.py, tests/test_main.py, and static/screenshots. Confirm behavior and run the standard unittest suite before any commit.
acceptance_criteria: Relevant tests pass or failures are documented; generated screenshots are handled intentionally; proxy/screenshot behavior is described in the bead before closing.

title: reconcile current uncommitted runtime changes
description: Review the pre-existing dirty worktree changes in config.json, main.py, screenshot.py, tests, and generated screenshots. Decide what belongs to a commit, what is generated output, and what should stay local.
acceptance_criteria: Each pre-existing runtime change is either committed intentionally, reverted by explicit human request, ignored as local/generated, or documented in a follow-up bead.

title: bootstrap Beads tracking for Quiosco

acceptance_criteria: Beads is initialized with prefix quiosco; CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md document the shared bd workflow; baseline migration issue is closed after validation.
close_reason: Beads initialized with prefix quiosco, remote configured, baseline issues created, and AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md updated with shared bd workflow.

title: document production deployment checklist cleanup
description: Review README.md and docs/manual-operativo.md for operational deployment checklist accuracy after the recent documentation and runtime changes.
acceptance_criteria: Deployment checklist is consistent with current config, screenshot/proxy behavior, and Beads workflow; any stale instructions are corrected or captured in follow-up beads.

title: review Copilot UptimeRobot auxiliary docs
description: Review docs/uptimerobot-data-contract.md and docs/copilot-studio-uptimerobot-power-automate.md as auxiliary external-integration material, separate from the core Chromecast runtime.
